dogecoin.text: Dogeuni wallet solves the pain point that the Dogecoin chain could only transfer DOGE in the past and could not play NFT and DeFi.  From then on, Dogecoin truly possesses the concept of "asset" rather than just a simple payment tool.

🔹 DogeUni Wallet [$Duni]: A Chrome plug-in wallet for asset management on the Dogecoin chain based on the Cardinals protocol, allowing users to easily manage their NFTs, inscription tokens and assets on the Dogecoin mainnet just like using an Ethereum wallet.

🔹 Cardinals Protocol implements advanced functions such as token issuance (Meme20), swap, staking, and cross-indexing through programmable UTXOs, providing a extensible framework for DeFi, NFT, and meme assets to flourish in the Dogecoin ecosystem.

🔹 Cardinals Protocol [$Cardi]: A next-generation modular protocol built on the Dogecoin blockchain that does not rely on smart contracts or Layer 2 chains, bringing smart, scalable, and decentralized features directly to the Dogecoin's Layer1.

The three musketeers of the Dogecoin ecosystem:

Cardinals Protocol ($CARDI)
DogeUni Wallet ($DUNI)
DogePump ($DPP)
